messages:
Alex K: Hey team — quick onboarding Qs about benefits/payroll. I joined on Mon and haven't seen my health insurance card yet. Is that mailed or digital?
Sam HR: Congrats + welcome Alex! :tada: Health cards are digital first — login to the Benefits Portal: https://benefits.redwood.ai (link). Paper cards are only mailed on request. Did you get the enrollment confirmation email?
Alex K: I didn't see any confirmation. I tried the portal with my work email and it said "pending enrollment".
Sam HR: Hmm. If it says pending, you probably need to complete the final signature. Can you DM me your employee ID? I can manually kick it through. Enrollment deadline is 30 days from your start date.
Alex K: Thanks — sending DM now. Also, small one: I had relocation airfare to file. Do we use Expensify or Ramp for reimbursements?
Noah T: We use Expensify for one-off reimbursements. Use category "Relocation" and attach your receipt PDF. It usually routes to People Ops for approval.
Jordan M: Tip — mark the expense as "relocation" and add a short note about the job offer date, saved me a back-and-forth last time.
Alex K: Cool. Any idea when my first paycheck will hit? I set up direct deposit but I didn't get a stub yet.
Payroll Bot: Payroll Bot: First paycheck for employees who started 2026-02-17 will process with pay date 2026-03-05. Stubs are emailed and available in the payroll portal.
Alex K: Awesome, thanks. One last thing — do we have floating holidays or an official holiday calendar to add to my calendar?
Sam HR: We publish the company holiday calendar in the handbook and it's linked in the People Ops channel pinned messages. We do 10 company holidays + 2 floaters. If you want the .ics, I can DM it.
Alex K: Please DM the .ics — that'd be great. Also, what about state tax forms? I filed federal W-4 but I wasn't sure about the CA DE 4.
Sam HR: Good call — for CA employees you need DE-4. For other states, state-specific withholding forms apply. I can send the right form link once I know your state.
Alex K: I'm in CA. Sending in DM. Thanks everyone — this helped a lot. :raised_hands: 
Sam HR: No problem — if anything else pops up ping @people-ops or me directly. Welcome aboard! :wave: 
Jordan M: Welcome Alex! :rocket:
